t.description: Bar open time, epoch milliseconds UTC.

Capsule.description: The live, openable, portable presentation of a single finding.

depth.description: Depth the capsule is shown at by default.

finding.description: Id of the finding it presents.

revision.description: Number of live updates so far.

story.description:
The story (R3): theme, stage, families, ledger at birth, history. Absent on
capsules written before R3.

view.description: Id of the view used when the capsule is opened.

CapsuleState.description:
Lifecycle state of a capsule:
`draft -> live -> (updated)* -> invalidated | expired | approved | rejected`.

oneOf.description: Updates itself as its series change.

ColorSpec.description:
The colour channel: constant, conditional or bound to a value.

A colour is `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa` or a theme token (`up`, `down`, `accent`, `text`,
`muted`, `warn`, `s1`…`s8`; see `docs/GRAMMAR.md` §Tema).

ColorSteps.description:
Colour chosen per bar by the value of a field, in steps:
`colors[i]` for `thresholds[i-1] <= value < thresholds[i]`.

ColorWhen.description: Colour chosen per bar by a condition.

else.description: Colour where it does not (and where a side is `null`).

Condition.description: A condition evaluated over series (invalidation, intent trigger).

oneOf.description: Last value of a series compared against a constant.

One series compared against another, both at the last bar (and the bar before,
for crossings). E.g. SMA(20) crosses above SMA(50):
`{"kind":"compare","left":"sma20","op":"cross_above","right":"sma50"}`.
For a bar series the compared value is the close.
Free text; evaluated by a person.

DataBinding.description: A data binding: what a bound series' data is, without the data (K23).

anchor_t.description:
Time of bar 0 as fixed by the authority on first resolution (§18.3). Written by the
authority (an engine entry), never by clients; once set, every resolution (the
authority's after a restart, each replica's) starts at this bar, so bar numbers and
the calculation start are the same everywhere.

feed.description:
Named feed of the host (e.g. `matriks`, `delayed`); the host's default if absent
(same id pattern as the symbol).

DataRef.description:
A reference to a field of a series: `{"series": "sma50", "field": "sma"}`. Within a
layer, `series` may be omitted (the layer's own data); `field` may be omitted for the
series' main output (`c` for bars).

field.description:
Field name: a bar field (`o`, `h`, `l`, `c`, `v`), a study output (`rsi`,
`upper`, `histogram`...), `v` for a point series, or a fact/finding field.

series.description: Series id; the layer's own series when absent.

Depth.description: Semantic zoom level: 0 sentence, 1 capsule, 2 marked chart, 3 full workspace.

Edge.description: Whether a fact is a point event, or the start or end of a state.

oneOf.description: A point event (a crossing, a breakout).
A state started (RSI went above 70 and stays there while the state holds).

Emphasis.description:
A persistent emphasis on part of a view (a finding, a layer, a bar range). Attention
directives and narration steps use the same target and are drawn the same way, but
they are presence, not document.

target.description: What is emphasised. `item` (a fact or finding) resolves to its bars.

EmphasisKind.description: How an emphasis changes the drawing.

oneOf.description: Mark the target (accent band behind its bars, thicker stroke for its layer).

Encoding.description:
The closed set of encoding channels. Unknown channel names are rejected
(`schema`, with `did_you_mean`).

color.description: Colour (stroke for lines and rules, fill for areas, bands, bars and points).

size.description: Size in pixels (point diameter, text size).

text.description:
Text of a `text` mark: a field of the layer's data (`text` of a fact, `claim` of a
finding).

width.description: Stroke width in pixels (lines, rules, band edges).

x.description: Horizontal position. Default: the row's bar. A constant makes a vertical rule.

x2.description:
Second horizontal position (R3): the last bar of a bar extent. With `x`, a
horizontal `rule` becomes a segment from bar `x` to bar `x2` (sloped when `y2` is
also given), and a `band`/`area` covers only bars `x..=x2` (evidence geometry,
`docs/GRAMMAR.md` §18).

y.description:
Vertical position. Default: the main output of the layer's series (`c` for bars,
`v` for points, `level` for facts); for `line` on a multi-output study, one line
per default output.

y2.description: Second vertical position: the lower edge of `band`/`area`, the base of `bar`.

EvidenceFamily.description: Evidence family (K30). Several facts from one family count as one confirmation.

oneOf.description: Price and indicators computed from price.

EvidenceRef.description:
Frozen evidence: the data a fact rests on, by reference and content digest (K23).
Stamped by the authority when a fact is added; `verify_evidence` re-checks it.

bars.description: Number of bars in the range.

binding.description: The binding of that series at stamping time (absent for inline data).

digest.description: [`data_digest`] of the bars in the range.

from_t.description: Time of the first bar of the range (inclusive).

series.description:
The bar series the evidence lies on (the fact's series, or the bar series a study
series is computed from).

to_t.description: Time of the last bar of the range (inclusive): the fact's bar.

Fact.description: An indisputable numeric event detected by the engine. Carries its evidence.

evidence_ref.description:
Frozen evidence (RP2): the data this fact rests on, by reference and content
digest; stamped by the authority (`docs/PROTOCOL.md` §18.5). Clients never send it.

meaning.description:
Meaning (R3): kind, direction, family, time kind, detector, license, geometry.
Absent on facts written before R3.

series.description: Id of the series the event happened on.

FactMeaning.description:
The meaning of a fact (R3): what a detector found, in the six-kind vocabulary.
Optional on [`crate::Fact`]; facts written before R3 have none.

condition.description:
Machine-checkable condition of an expectation (`time = expectation`) or of a
state's continuation (`time = state`): a sentence slot, not free text.

detector_version.description: Detector version; part of the ledger key.

edge.description: Edge: a point event, or a state's start or end.

server.description: `true` when produced on the server from licensed data (server fact, K33).

facts.description: Ids of the facts the claim rests on.

invalidation.description: When this condition holds, the finding is invalid.

key.description: Evidence key of the value at that bar.

Geometry.description:
Evidence geometry: what the chart depth draws for a fact. Values are never stored
here; they are keys into [`crate::Fact::evidence`], so redacting the evidence removes
the geometry's numbers too.

oneOf.description: A horizontal level from one bar to another (a broken resistance, a threshold).

key.description: Evidence key of the level value.

oneOf.description: A band between two evidence values over a bar range (a squeeze's band).

lower.description: Evidence key of the lower value.

upper.description: Evidence key of the upper value.

oneOf.description: Marked points (swing peaks of a divergence): one bar and one evidence key each.

points.description: `(bar, evidence key)` pairs, in bar order.

Glyph.description: A one-glance visual of meaning, not data.

GlyphKind.description: Kind of meaning glyph (initial candidate set; finalized in R3).

oneOf.description: Has it happened before, and what followed?
What changed since the last look?

Instrument.description: A traded asset: where it trades and which calendar aligns its bars (K14).

calendar.description: Calendar id, e.g. `XIST`, `XNYS`. Bars are aligned to this calendar.

Intent.description: A persistent request left by the user, e.g. "tell me if the uptrend breaks".

active.description: Whether the intent is still active.

matches.description: (R5B, §25.5) How many times the watch matched.

state.description: (R5B, §25.5) Lifecycle state of a watch (absent: an intent before R5B).

text.description: The request as the user said it.

trigger.description: Machine-checkable trigger, if one could be derived.

watch.description: (R5B, §25.5) A structured watch on story transitions, matched by the engine.

Layer.description:
One layer of a view: a mark bound to data through encoding channels.

Data is at most one of `series`, `fact`, `finding`. A layer with none of them draws
only constants, and every constant needs an origin.

fact.description: Data: one fact (one row: `bar`, `t`, `value`, `text` and its evidence keys).

finding.description: Data: the facts of a finding (one row per fact, plus `claim`, `confidence`).

id.description: Stable id, unique within the view. Assigned when absent.

label.description: Legend text; derived from the data when absent (e.g. `SMA20`).

origin.description:
Origins of the layer's numeric constants, keyed by JSON pointer inside the layer
(`"/encoding/y"`, `"/encoding/color/when/than"`,
`"/encoding/color/thresholds/0"`). Filled by the authority when it can trace a
constant (see `docs/GRAMMAR.md` §Köken); a constant may also be omitted when an
origin is given, and the authority writes its value.

panel.description: Id of the panel the layer is drawn in (not a position).

bar.description: Bar at which the outcome was decided (R3).

stage.description:
Closing stage (R3): `realized`, `invalidated` or `expired` (`retracted` is never
recorded, K37).

state.description: Final capsule state, if any (e.g. approved / rejected by a person).

LedgerStat.description: Ledger statistic for one key (meaning kind + detector), as seen at some time.

n.description: Closed capsules counted (realized + invalidated + expired; never retracted).

License.description: License class of the data a fact rests on (K33).

class.description:
`public`: the user's own data entitlement for the bar series is enough to see the
values (the replica can recompute it). `licensed`: rests on data only the server
may read; computed only on the server (server fact) and shown to an unentitled
user as a comment without numbers.

entitlement.description: The data entitlement needed to see the evidence values (`flow/THYAO`, `flow/*`).

oneOf.description: Recomputable from the user's own bar data.
Server-only data; numbers never reach an unentitled user.
Polyline through `y` (one line per default output when `y` is absent).
Fill from `y` down to `y2`, or to the bottom of the panel when `y2` is absent.
Vertical columns from `y2` (default 0, clamped to the panel) to `y`.
Horizontal (`y`) or vertical (`x`) reference line across the panel.
Text label at (`x`, `y`); the text comes from the `text` channel.
Fill between two values `y` and `y2` (both required): bands, envelopes, fans.

Meaning glyph (R3, `docs/GRAMMAR.md` §18) of the capsule that presents the layer's
`finding`; drawn by the product alphabet from the capsule's glyph parameters.

MeaningCondition.description:
A machine-checkable condition attached to a meaning (sentence slot).

(R4, K42/A28) The same shape serves two different roles, which a story keeps in two
separate fields ([`Story::condition`], [`Story::resolution`]):

- **state condition** (durum koşulu): whether the claim still holds **now** ("RSI is
  above 70", "the close is still above the broken level"); it decides the capsule's
  [`Validity`];
- **expected resolution** (beklenen çözüm): how the story is expected to close ("a
  close outside the band within 20 bars"); a state may have ended while the story is
  still open.

On a fact ([`FactMeaning::condition`]) the role follows from the time kind
(`qp_capsule::sentence::split_condition`): a state's condition with `within_bars` is
its expected resolution, an expectation's condition is what resolves it, and every
other condition is a state condition.

key.description: Evidence key of the threshold value.

within_bars.description: Within how many bars (expectation), if bounded.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

oneOf.description: Devam: the move goes on (trend, MA alignment, flag).
Dönüş: the move may be turning (divergence, double top/bottom).
Kırılım: a boundary was crossed (range, channel, support/resistance).
Sıkışma: the move is narrowing; direction unknown (band squeeze, low volatility).
Aşırılık: unusual stretch (overbought/oversold, outside the band).
Akış: money in/out independent of price (volume, settlement, institutional flow).

Op.description: The operation a command performs on a document.

oneOf.description: Add or replace a series binding (by id).
Add or replace a view (by id).
Move a capsule to a new lifecycle state.

anyOf.description: A field of the layer's data or of another series.

Operand.description: Right-hand side of a condition: a constant (needs an [`Origin`]) or a field.

Origin.description:
Where a numeric constant of a layer comes from (principle 6). The authority rejects a
constant it cannot trace (`no_origin`).

oneOf.description:
A field of a fact: an evidence key (`level`), or `bar` / `t` / `value`, or (R3) a
bar of the fact's evidence geometry: `geometry.<i>.from_bar`,
`geometry.<i>.to_bar`, `geometry.<i>.points.<j>.bar` (`docs/GRAMMAR.md` §18).

A named threshold of a study, e.g. `rsi.overbought` (70). The list is the
engine's (`describe` → `thresholds`).
A value of a series (live: no constant is written, the value follows the data).

Outcome.description: Outcome of a finding compared against what actually happened.

Panel.description:
One horizontal strip of a view. Panels are stacked top to bottom in list order and
share the view's time axis; each has its own value scale.

id.description:
Stable panel id (a number, unique within the view). It is **not** the position:
moving or inserting panels never changes it. Layers refer to it (`Layer::panel`).
Assigned (largest id + 1) when absent.

name.description: Optional name for people and for reference by meaning, e.g. `"price"`, `"rsi"`.

weight.description: Relative height (> 0). Default: 3 for the first panel, 1 for the others.

PanelPos.description:
A panel-relative layout position (R3, `docs/GRAMMAR.md` §18): `panel` is the fraction
of the panel's width (`x`) or height (`y`) from its left/top edge, `px` a pixel offset
added to it. A layout constant, like a size: it claims nothing about the data, so it
needs no [`Origin`]. Used by `text` and `glyph` (a capsule card's sentence, ledger line
and glyph).

panel.description: Fraction `0..=1` of the panel's extent from its left (`x`) or top (`y`) edge.

px.description: Pixel offset added to it (may be negative).

Point.description:
One point of a single-valued series (e.g. an indicator output).

Warmup rule (K13): a study output always has one point per input bar, at the same
`t`. Points inside the warmup period have `v: null`; nothing is trimmed.

t.description: Point time, epoch milliseconds UTC (the time of the bar it belongs to).

anyOf.description: Field name, or a numeric constant written as a string.
Panel-relative layout position (not data; needs no origin).

Predicate.description: A per-bar condition: `field op than`, e.g. `{"field":"c","op":"ge","than":{"field":"o"}}`.

field.description: Left-hand field of the layer's data.

Provenance.description: Who produced an item, based on what, and when.

approved_by.description:
Who approved it, when it entered the document through an accepted proposal
(protocol: `accept_proposal`). Absent for direct writes.

based_on.description: Ids of the items this one is based on.

Resolution.description:
How a story is expected to close (R4, K42/A28: the **expected resolution**, kept apart
from the state condition).

condition.description:
The resolution the detector names, if any (a squeeze: "a close outside the band
within 20 bars"; an expectation: its condition).

rule.description:
The outcome rule that closes the story (`barrier`: the per-kind volatility
barrier, M5); its natural life is [`Story::horizon_bars`].

Scale.description: A scale mapping data values to a visual axis.

domain.description:
Fixed domain `[min, max]`; automatic (fit to the visible data, 5 % padding) when
absent. On the time axis this is the view's **persistent range** in epoch ms
(`set_view_range`); a connection's transient viewport is presence, not this.

id.description:
Stable id within the view: `"x"` for the time axis, `"y<panel id>"` for a panel's
value scale. Filled by the authority; if given it must match.

oneOf.description:
Bar-ordered time (horizontal only): one slot per bar of the view's first bar
series; session gaps (nights, weekends, holidays) take no space. `domain` is in
epoch milliseconds.
Base-10 logarithmic numeric; values `<= 0` are not drawn.

Series.description:
Time-based numeric data: bars, an indicator output or a stream.

In a [`Document`] a series acts as a binding: `source` says where data comes
from and `data` may be omitted.

instrument.description:
The instrument the series belongs to, if any. Its symbol lives here (there is no
separate `symbol` field), so exchange and calendar travel with it (K14).

SeriesAt.description: Which value of a series an [`Origin::Series`] takes.

SeriesSource.description: Where a series comes from. The core does not depend on the kind of source.

oneOf.description: Data is embedded in the series itself (`data`).

A data binding (RP2, K23): the series' bars come from the data plane, resolved
per principal by the host's source provider; the document carries no bars
(`docs/PROTOCOL.md` §18). Fields as in [`crate::data::DataBinding`].

anchor_t.description: Time of bar 0, fixed by the authority on first resolution (engine entry; §18.3).

feed.description: Named feed of the host; the host's default if absent.

window.description: Which bars: `{"last": n}`, `{"from_t": t}` or `{"from_t": a, "to_t": b}`.

oneOf.description: Local computation: a study applied to other series.

output.description: Which output of a multi-output study, if any.

SizeByField.description: Size bound to a field, mapped linearly onto `range` pixels over the visible values.

SizeSpec.description: Size channel (point diameter, text size), in pixels.

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

oneOf.description:
Aday: seen on an open bar; only on the watching replica; never in the authority's
log or the ledger.
Doğdu: finalized on bar close; the authority gave it an id.
Güçlendi: a new supporting fact of the same family.
Zayıfladı: a fact against it, or its state weakened.
Teyit edildi: a second (or further) independent evidence family supports it.
Gerçekleşti: the outcome rule says it came true. Closes; ledger hit.
Geçersiz: its invalidation happened. Closes; ledger miss.
Süresi doldu: its natural life (in bars) ended without an outcome. Closes; ledger miss.
Geri çekildi: the data it rested on proved wrong (K37). Closes; NOT in the ledger.

Story.description: The story a capsule tells (R3). Optional on [`crate::Capsule`].

born_bar.description: Bar the story was born on.

condition.description:
(R4, K42/A28) The **state condition**: whether the claim still holds now (from the
fact that gave birth). Absent when the claim has none (a squeeze's band, an
expectation) and on stories written before R4.

families.description: Independent evidence families that support it (sorted, unique).

horizon_bars.description: Natural life in bars from birth (expiry by bar count, never by clock).

importance.description: Importance score from the ranking rule (higher = more important).

ledger_at_birth.description: Ledger at birth: only capsules closed before the birth bar (no look-ahead).

ledger_key.description:
Ledger key (`kind/direction/detector@version`; R4, K42/A23: up, down and neutral
stories of one detector are counted apart).

resolution.description:
(R4, K42/A28) The **expected resolution**: how the story is expected to close.
Absent on stories written before R4.

series.description: The bar series the story lives on.

theme.description: Theme key: same instrument + same theme → one story (K28).

tier.description: Importance tier: 1 most important … 3 least (sensitivity filters on it).

Target.description: A step of a narration or an attention directive points at something.

from_bar.description: First bar index (0-based) of the region.

output.description: Output or field of the series, e.g. `"v"` (volume of a bar series), `"signal"`.

series.description: Series id (e.g. the series whose value matters).

to_bar.description: Last bar index (inclusive) of the region; equal to `from_bar` for one bar.

TimeKind.description: The three time kinds of a capsule (K27).

oneOf.description: Olay: happened at a bar; past tense with its time; freshness fades.
Durum: holds while the condition holds; present tense; ends when it breaks.
Beklenti: conditional; lives until the condition is met or voided.

Transition.description: One transition in a capsule's story.

bar.description: Bar index (of the story's bar series) at which it happened.

Trust.description: How a capsule reached the user; drives the "verified by" mark (K38).

oneOf.description: The replica can re-check it on its own data (consistency rule, §19).

Server fact: the replica cannot re-check it (licensed data); shown as verified
by the server.

View.description: A presentation recipe written in the visual grammar.

display_tz.description: Display time zone override (IANA); display only, see `Document::display_tz`.

layers.description: Layers, drawn in order (later layers on top).

theme.description:
Theme name (`dark`, the default, or `light`). The theme lives in the engine, not
in the view: the same view can be drawn with another theme.

title.description:
Optional title; derived from the first bar series (symbol and interval) when
absent.

y.description:
**Deprecated (`qp/0`).** Value scales by panel position. The authority converts
it into `panels` (ids `0..n`) when loading; do not write both.

Watch.description:
(R5B, §25.5) A structured watch: whom it is for, what story transitions match, until
when and how often.

expires_t.description: The watch expires when the clock reaches this time (epoch ms); never if absent.

for.description: The person it is for (principal id).

max_matches.description: The watch ends after this many matches; never if absent.

WatchMatch.description: (R5B, §25.5) What story transitions a watch matches. Every given field must hold.

holdings.description: Only instruments the person holds (non-zero position in their audience).

Window.description:
Which bars a binding asks for.

Wire form: exactly one of `{"last": n}`, `{"from_t": t}`, `{"from_t": a, "to_t": b}`
(inclusive). Bar numbers of a bound series count from the first bar of the window as
resolved by the authority (its *anchor*, announced in the `binding` query); bars that
arrive later are appended, the window does not slide.

last.description: The last `n` bars at resolution time.

to_t.description: With `from_t`: bars with `t <= to_t`; the window is closed (no live bars).

description: The only way to change a document. Humans and agents use the same commands.

provenance.description: Who issued the command and when.

title: Command
